presets.label: Check-in time?
presets.userText: Hi, what time can I check in?
presets.reply: Check-in from 14:00. If you need early arrival — let me know and I'll check availability with the manager.

presets.label: Is there parking?
presets.reply: Yes, there's a secured courtyard. I'll send the gate code one hour before check-in along with the instructions.

presets.label: Pets allowed?
presets.userText: Can I bring my cat? He's small :)
presets.reply: Pets welcome — up to 10 kg. A $30 refundable deposit is required, returned after checkout. Shall I send an invoice?

presets.label: Noise complaint
presets.userText: Neighbours upstairs are making noise all night, it's 2 AM. Impossible to sleep.
presets.reply: Understood — this is unacceptable. Connecting the manager immediately; they will call you within a few minutes.

presets.label: Lock code not working
presets.userText: The door code doesn't work, I can't get in. I'm standing outside.
presets.reply: On it. Backup code: 4921. If that doesn't work — I'm calling the manager right now.

presets.label: No Wi-Fi
presets.userText: The Wi-Fi isn't working, what should I do?
presets.reply: Try restarting the router — it's behind the TV. Password: home_apt_2024. If that fails I'll dispatch a technician.

presets.label: Extend by one night
presets.userText: Can I stay one more night, tomorrow the 26th?
presets.reply: Checking... The 26th is free. Rate: $85. Shall I issue the invoice now?

presets.label: Early check-out
presets.userText: Can I check out at 10:00 instead of 12:00? Early flight.
presets.reply: Of course, early check-out at 10:00 confirmed. Just leave the key in the lockbox by the door.

presets.label: No hot water
presets.userText: There's been no hot water for an hour. What happened?
presets.reply: Checking building status... Scheduled maintenance until 15:00. If it's not restored by 15:30 — let me know immediately.

presets.label: Loyalty discount
presets.userText: This is our third stay — can we get a discount for the next booking?
presets.reply: Marking you as a returning guest. Here's a 10% promo code for your next booking: LOYALTY10.

presets.label: Leaking tap
presets.userText: The tap in the bathroom is leaking and I can't stop it.
presets.reply: Got it. Turn off the valve under the sink (turn right). I'm dispatching a plumber urgently — they'll arrive within an hour.

presets.label: Extra towels
presets.userText: Could I get some extra towels?
presets.reply: Of course. I'll flag this for housekeeping — they'll deliver within 30 minutes. Anything else you need?

problem.title: Guest communication that doesn't scale
problem.subtitle: Most short-term rental operators manage guest messages manually — and it breaks down as volume grows.

pains.title: Every message needs a human
pains.desc: Check-in questions, access codes, late arrivals, house rules. Each one interrupts someone's day. At 5 properties it's manageable. At 15 it's a full-time job.

pains.title: Context lives in someone's head
pains.desc: Which guest is arriving? What are the parking rules for that unit? What did they ask last week? When staff changes, that knowledge disappears.

pains.title: Issues escalate because no one triages
pains.desc: A broken appliance and a Wi-Fi question arrive with the same urgency. Without routing logic, operators are constantly context-switching.

pains.title: Payments are a separate manual step
pains.desc: Collecting fees for late check-out, early check-in, or add-on services means chasing guests across channels. There's no clean path from request to payment.

solution.title: A communication layer that knows your property.
solution.desc: ASI sits between your guests and your operations. It understands message intent, matches reservation context, applies property knowledge, and decides what to do — reply, process a payment, or hand off to the operator.
solution.highlight: Not a chatbot. An operations layer that handles guest communication the way a trained operator would — available around the clock, grounded in your actual property context.

features.title: Built capabilities
features.subtitle: What ASI does today — not a roadmap.

items.title: Intelligent guest communication
items.desc: Understands message intent across inquiry types — check-in, issues, service requests, complaints. Responds in natural language grounded in property knowledge.

items.title: Reservation-aware routing
items.desc: Matches incoming messages to active reservations. Applies different logic for confirmed guests, pre-booking inquiries, and post-checkout contacts.

items.title: Multilingual support
items.desc: Detects guest language automatically. Handles English and Russian natively, with architecture ready for additional languages.

items.title: Payment processing
items.desc: Sends payment links directly in the conversation. Supports Stripe (international) and YooKassa (Russia). Confirms payment and triggers next steps automatically.

items.title: Operator escalation & handoff
items.desc: Recognizes when a situation requires human judgment — urgent issues, low-confidence responses, unusual requests. Transfers full context to the operator cleanly.

items.title: Issue triage
items.desc: Classifies guest issues by type and urgency. Separates noise from critical problems. Routes maintenance, access, and complaint messages appropriately.

items.title: Property knowledge grounding
items.desc: Responses are grounded in your property's rules, policies, and operational context — not generic answers. Configure once, apply consistently across all messages.

items.title: Channel-ready architecture
items.desc: Currently operational on Telegram. Built channel-agnostically for expansion to WhatsApp, email, and booking platform messaging without core changes.

steps.title: Message arrives
steps.desc: A guest sends a message. ASI receives it and runs intent classification to understand what they need — check-in help, a service request, a payment, or something that needs a human.

steps.title: Reservation context matched
steps.desc: The system identifies the guest's reservation, property, and relevant history. This context shapes the response — confirmed guests get different handling than pre-booking inquiries.

steps.title: Knowledge-grounded decision
steps.desc: ASI applies property policies, house rules, and operational knowledge to determine the right action. No generic answers — responses are specific to your property.

steps.title: Response, payment, or handoff
steps.desc: Guest gets an accurate reply, a payment link, or confirmation that a human will follow up. If escalation is triggered, the operator receives full context — not just a forwarded message.

useCases.title: What this looks like in practice
useCases.subtitle: Six scenarios that happen every day in short-term rental operations.

items.guest: Is the apartment suitable for a family with two small children?
items.asi: ASI pulls property details and house rules, confirms suitability, and answers the question — without involving the operator.

items.guest: How do I get in? My flight lands at 11pm.
items.asi: ASI matches the reservation, retrieves access instructions, confirms the late arrival works, and sends the door code — all from the property knowledge base.
ASI classifies the issue, acknowledges the guest immediately, logs it for the operator, and escalates with unit number, reservation ID, and issue description.

items.guest: Can I check out at 1pm instead of 11am?
items.asi: ASI confirms availability, quotes the late check-out fee, and sends a payment link via Stripe or YooKassa. The checkout time updates once payment clears.
ASI detects Russian, switches language, matches the reservation, and replies with check-in time and access instructions in Russian.

items.guest: There's a water leak — it's coming through the ceiling.
items.asi: ASI immediately notifies the operator with reservation details and property location, acknowledges the guest, and flags the issue as requiring urgent action.

trust.title: Built for operators, not around hype
trust.subtitle: Direct answers to the questions operators actually ask.

items.q: Is there always a human fallback?
items.a: Yes. Escalation is a core part of the system, not an afterthought. When confidence is low or the situation is complex, ASI hands off to the operator with full context. You stay in control.
The current channel is Telegram. The architecture is channel-agnostic and built for expansion. Adding channels doesn't require rebuilding the communication logic.

items.q: Does this replace our existing setup?
items.a: No. ASI layers on top of your current operations. It doesn't require replacing your PMS, channel manager, or booking flow — it connects to what's already there.

items.q: Can we configure what it handles?
items.a: Yes. Property knowledge, escalation thresholds, and response policies are all configurable. The system adapts to your operational context, not the other way around.
Early production / pilot. The communication module and payment layer are live. We're onboarding pilot properties now and working closely with initial operators.
